subject.title: feat(write): add append mode to prevent silent data loss

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as append?: boolean on write, switch to a mode field, or use a separate append tool before this PR lands?
rationale: The linked data-loss problem is well supported, but the permanent model-facing write contract and backend operation contract are maintainer-owned API choices.

options.title: Accept append boolean after contract cleanup
options.body: Keep this PR's additive append?: boolean shape, clarify the backend operation comment, and preserve default overwrite behavior.

options.title: Switch to mode
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit mode field if maintainers want a more extensible write contract.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want overwrite and append to remain distinct model-facing tools.

recommendation.title: Accept append boolean after contract cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's additive append?: boolean shape, clarify the backend operation comment, and preserve default overwrite behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing signal for the agent runtime/tool API boundary decision among the sampled history.
